copy.titleEn: A PAUSE ON THE HARBOR STEPS

title.en: A pause on the harbor steps

deck.en: A cold glass and a seat on warm stone.

intro.ko: 햇볕에 데워진 돌계단에 걸터앉아 맥주 한 잔. 넉넉한 코발트 티셔츠와 밝은 스톤 쇼츠는 앉고 일어서기 편하고, 빛바랜 블루 캡이 티셔츠 색을 한 톤 부드럽게 받아 줘요.
intro.en: Perched on sun-warmed stone steps with a beer. A roomy cobalt tee and pale drawstring shorts make sitting down and getting up easy, while a faded blue cap repeats the shirt colour a shade softer.
intro.de: Auf sonnenwarmen Steinstufen, ein Bier in der Hand. Ein weites kobaltblaues Shirt und helle Shorts mit Kordelzug machen Hinsetzen und Aufstehen leicht; die verwaschene Cap wiederholt das Blau eine Spur sanfter.

tip.ko: 계단이나 낮은 벽에 앉을 날엔 무릎 위 길이 쇼츠가 앉았을 때 너무 짧아지지 않는지 한 번 확인하세요.
tip.en: If you will be sitting on steps or low walls, check that above-the-knee shorts do not ride up too far once you sit.
tip.de: Wer auf Stufen oder niedrigen Mauern sitzt, prüft kurz, ob Shorts über dem Knie im Sitzen nicht zu weit hochrutschen.

copy.refinements: Producer delivered titles only (ko/en/de). deck ko/de = producer title, en deck rewritten so it does not repeat the English article title; intro, pull and tip written from the editorial scene. Product how-to-wear = producer text except where noted by sourceHowToWear (production remark or missing verb).
